title: Coal Situation in China Still Bullish
section_path: Coal Situation in China Still Bullish
section_path_text: Coal Situation in China Still Bullish
summary:
Main
By Jeffrey Landsberg
As we discussed in Commodore Research's most recent Weekly Executive Report, China's coal production totaled 361.8 million tons in August. This is up month-on-month by 18.6 million tons (5%) but down year-on-year by 28.6 million tons (-7%). Remaining very significant is that the last time there was any year-on-year growth was back in June 2025.
